maddeler.e:
نشمأز (form IVq)
# نُشْمَأَزُّ (nušmaʔazzu) /nuʃ.ma.ʔaz.zu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# نُشْمَأَزَّ (nušmaʔazza) /nuʃ.ma.ʔaz.za/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# نُشْمَأَزِّ (nušmaʔazzi) /nuʃ.ma.ʔaz.zi/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
